cloudId.title: Cloud ID
cloudId.description: 6-character Cloud ID from the label on the underside of the device.

installCode.title: Install Code
installCode.description: 16-character Install Code from the label on the underside of the device.

host.title: Host
host.description: IP address or mDNS hostname of the EAGLE-200. If omitted, defaults to eagle-<cloudId>.local (mDNS).

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll the EAGLE-200 for new meter data. Minimum 5 seconds.

meterName.title: Import Meter Display Name
meterName.description: HomeKit display name for the import meter accessory. Defaults to 'Grid Meter - Import' when showExportMeter is true.

showExportMeter.title: Show Export Meter
showExportMeter.description: Register a second Eve Energy accessory showing power exported to the grid (net metering / solar).

exportMeterName.title: Export Meter Display Name
exportMeterName.description: HomeKit display name for the export meter accessory. Only used when showExportMeter is true.

matter.title: Show in the Apple Home Energy view (via Matter)
matter.description: Also publish the grid meter over Matter as a single bidirectional electrical sensor with live power and cumulative/periodic energy, feeding your Apple Home Energy view (requires iOS/iPadOS 27+ to view). Requires Homebridge 2.4.0+ with Matter enabled on this plugin's child bridge; skipped safely otherwise.

evePowerUpdates.title: Eve Power Updates

oneOf.title: Poll only — never push (breaks Eve/Home+ triggers on these values)

evePowerUpdates.description: How the Eve Watts and Eve kWh values are sent to HomeKit. Eve and Home+ automations can trigger on or check these values: Throttled keeps them working, accurate to within the thresholds below. Poll only gives the lowest traffic but automations triggered by these values will not fire, so use it only if no automation uses them.

minChangeWatts.title: Minimum Change (W)
minChangeWatts.description: Throttled mode: push Eve Watts when power has changed by at least this many watts since the last push (or Minimum Change %, whichever is larger).

minChangePercent.title: Minimum Change (%)
minChangePercent.description: Throttled mode: push Eve Watts when power has changed by at least this percentage of the last value pushed (or Minimum Change W, whichever is larger).

minChangeKwh.title: Minimum Change (kWh)
minChangeKwh.description: Throttled mode: push Eve kWh when the total has changed by at least this much since the last push.

maxIntervalSeconds.title: Maximum Interval (seconds)
maxIntervalSeconds.description: Throttled mode: push anyway once this long has passed since the last push, even if the change is small.

switchHoldSeconds.title: On Switch Hold (seconds)
switchHoldSeconds.description: The meter's On switch (importing / exporting) changes only after the new state has held this long, so brief spikes don't flip it. Automations triggered by the switch can fire up to this long after the underlying change. 0 disables the hold.
